identity.name: Sounding
identity.description: Analyze one agent session with your own questions. Whole-session questions (yes/no, number, text, choices, findings, keyword search) use the scanner engine of inspect_scout; per-item judging (every user message or tool call) uses Jev, and its hits can point the whole-session question at the right places. Questions and results stay in Berth, not in the project.
